entries.name: PlayStation Payload Center
entries.author: Pharaoh2k
entries.desc: Cross-platform Avalonia/.NET desktop tool. Discover consoles, browse payload catalogs, SHA-256 verify, queue, and stream payloads to jailbroken PS4/PS5.
entries.notes: UDP discovery (PS4:987, PS5:9302). Common send ports 9020/9021.

entries.name: ps5-payload-manager
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Modern web-based dashboard that runs on the PS5 itself. Manage, import, and auto-load payloads. Homescreen shortcut support.
entries.notes: Can be set as only entry in autoload.txt.

entries.name: PKG Sender
entries.author: Loopayeh
entries.desc: LAN PKG installer for PS4/PS5. Auto-find console, queue installs. No USB needed. Ships `pkg-receiver.elf` for PS5.
entries.notes: PS5 uses pkg-receiver.elf on port 12800. PS4 uses Remote Package Installer or GoldHEN.

entries.name: PS5-4-Payload-Sender-Android
entries.author: PixelPop25
entries.desc: Simple Android TCP payload injector. Supports .bin / .elf / .lua / .js / .jar.
entries.notes: Keep mobile data off so traffic stays on LAN.

entries.name: PS5AutopayloadHA
entries.author: cosmicflow2512
entries.desc: Home Assistant add-on that fully automates the post-exploit payload chain (send / delay / wait-for-port flows).
entries.notes: Supports multiple loaders (9021, 9025, 9026, 50000…).

entries.name: web-based-ps-package-manager
entries.author: h-haghpanah
entries.desc: Browser tool for managing and sending packages to PS4 and PS5.
entries.notes: PS5 side can use ps5_file_downloader (8283) or pkg_receiver (12800).

entries.name: Send-Payload-to-PS
entries.author: Master-s
entries.desc: Multi-platform payload sender including iOS support.
entries.notes: Has PC and iOS components.

entries.name: ps5-payload-dev/sdk
entries.author: ps5-payload-dev
entries.desc: SDK for developing PS5 payloads using dynamic linking. Works with elfldr, websrv, BD-J, remote_lua_loader, etc.
entries.notes: Install to `/opt/ps5-payload-sdk`. Essential for building native payloads.

entries.name: ps5-payload-dev/websrv
entries.author: ps5-payload-dev
entries.desc: Simple web server payload (port 8080). Launch homebrew and ELF payloads from the PS5 browser or remotely.
entries.notes: Looks for homebrew under `/data/homebrew`, USB, and external storage.

entries.name: ps5-payload-dev/elfldr
entries.author: ps5-payload-dev
entries.desc: ELF loader for jailbroken PS5s. Accepts payloads on port 9021.
entries.notes: Primary target for ZendRz and most PC senders.

entries.name: ps5-payload-dev/ftpsrv
entries.author: ps5-payload-dev
entries.desc: FTP server for jailbroken PS4 and PS5.
entries.notes: Common companion after HEN.

entries.name: ps5-payload-dev/fetchpkg
entries.author: ps5-payload-dev
entries.desc: Fetch PS4/PS5 package updates referenced by a JSON-formatted manifest URL.
entries.notes: Useful for update pipelines.

entries.name: etaHEN / forks
entries.author: MasterPS0
entries.desc: AIO HEN + toolbox for jailbroken PS5. Debug settings replacement, plugins, rest mode options, etc.
entries.notes: Many tools assume etaHEN or compatible environment is running.

entries.name: onionHEN
entries.desc: Homebrew enabler and toolbox built on top of etaHEN.
entries.notes: Frequently listed in payload mirrors.

entries.name: PIZZA-HEN
entries.author: Michele-M-Media
entries.desc: Experimental all-in-one PS5 homebrew environment with its own integration layer, Toolbox, service chain, and branding (builds on upstream open-source projects).
entries.notes: v2.00 public source checkpoint. Maintained by Michele Media.

entries.name: ShadowMountPlus
entries.author: drakmor
entries.desc: Automated background auto-mounter for jailbroken PS5. Detects, mounts, and installs game backups from internal/external storage. Supports UFS, exFAT, PFS, and nested compressed PFS containers.
entries.notes: Core for game library / KmprZ workflows. Very widely used.

entries.name: kstuff-lite
entries.author: EchoStretch
entries.desc: Lite kstuff build – crypto, FSELF, NPDRM, loader work. Optimized UELF/KELF transitions and diagnostics.
entries.notes: Popular base; many forks exist (including drakmor).

entries.name: kstuff-lite
entries.author: drakmor
entries.desc: drakmor fork of kstuff-lite with improved fpkg/FSELF handling, faster startup and internal optimizations.
entries.notes: Alternative optimized build.

entries.name: nanoDNS
entries.author: drakmor
entries.desc: PlayStation 4/5 DNS proxy server.
entries.notes: Local DNS proxy useful for blocking/redirecting Sony endpoints.

entries.name: ampr_emu
entries.author: drakmor
entries.desc: AMPR userland emulation.
entries.notes: Public beta; Discord linked from repo.

entries.name: BackPork
entries.author: BestPig
entries.desc: Lets you sideload system libraries into PS5 games.
entries.notes: Useful for advanced game patching / library injection.

entries.name: ps5debug-NG
entries.author: EchoStretch
entries.desc: PS5 debugger payload – userland TCP wire-protocol server hosted inside SceShellCore.
entries.notes: GPL-3. For development / reverse engineering.

entries.name: PS5 Account Activator
entries.author: Epinorr
entries.desc: All-in-one ELF that combines offline account activation + NP Fake Signin in a single execution. Idempotent, region-aware, clean on-screen notifications.
entries.notes: Send `AIO-Activator.elf` to the foreground user (port 9021). ~v2.1.0.

entries.name: np-fake-signin
entries.author: earthonion
entries.desc: Sets PSN state to "signed in" on PS4/PS5. Standalone NP fake sign-in (also folded into Account Activator AIO builds).
entries.notes: Primary GitHub home for the payload.

entries.name: ps5-account-tools
entries.author: MangoScango
entries.desc: Web UI (port 6769) to manage local PS5 accounts — offline activation + fake PSN sign-in in one place, plus local profile avatar change. Enables Remote Play pairing (Chiaki / Px Play).
entries.notes: After activation, note Account IDs, reboot, then pair remote play. Pair with nanoDNS to keep PSN blocked.

entries.name: ps5-fw-spoof
entries.author: illusionyy
entries.desc: Patch PS4 SDK + PS5 Update version in kernel data to `99.99` without hardcoded offsets.
entries.notes: Version spoof helper for tools that gate on FW/SDK version.

entries.name: ps5-self-pager
entries.author: idlesauce
entries.desc: PS5 SELF decryptor (“yet another PS5 SELF decryptor”).
entries.notes: Development / reverse-engineering utility.

entries.name: WelcomeHubActivator
entries.author: ghost1372
entries.desc: PS5 ELF payload that enables the Welcome Hub (FW 10.00–13.60). Requires prior fake account activation + fake sign-in (e.g. ProsperoManager / Account Activator).
entries.notes: One-shot; persists across reboots. Binary: `WelcomeHubActivator-org_v1.0.0.elf`. Backs up `app.db` → `app.bckdb` before edit. If activation fails, may need System *Feature* Update (not full System Software Update). Sign out/in after success.

entries.name: ps5upload
entries.desc: Fast, reliable file transfer between PC and PS5 (requires companion PC app).
entries.notes: Useful for pushing large game dumps or packages.

entries.name: ps5-webkit-autoloader
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Automated payload loader for exploited PS5 consoles (WebKit path).
entries.notes: Very popular (1k+ stars).

entries.name: ps5-bdjb-autoloader
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Automated payload loader for exploited PS5 consoles (BD-J path).
entries.notes: BD-J entry point automation.

entries.name: ps5-lua-autoloader
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Automated payload and Lua script loader for exploited PS5 consoles.
entries.notes: For Lua-based exploit chains.

entries.name: ps5-y2jb-autoloader
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Automated payload loader for exploited PS5 consoles (Y2JB path).
entries.notes: Very popular Y2JB automation (~900 stars).

entries.name: P2JB-Y2JB-Porting
entries.author: matem6
entries.desc: PS5 jailbreak via Y2JB. Ports Gezine’s p2jb kqueueex cr_ref overflow.
entries.notes: Exploit porting work around Y2JB / p2jb.

entries.name: Luac0re
entries.author: Gezine
entries.desc: mast1c0re variation that uses Lua scripting for easier exploit development.
entries.notes: Scriptable save-game exploit framework variant.

entries.name: mast1c0re
entries.author: McCaulay
entries.desc: Develop payloads that can be executed on PS4 or PS5 through a game save file.
entries.notes: Classic save-file payload framework. Docs: https://cturt.github.io/mast1c0re.html

entries.name: PS5-Super-PLDMGR-Auto-Updater
entries.author: nexgen999
entries.desc: Auto-updater focused on the PS5 Payload Manager (PLDMGR) ecosystem.
entries.notes: Keeps payload manager related components current.

entries.name: ps5-web-file-manager
entries.author: owendswang
entries.desc: File manager for PS5 with a web UI.
entries.notes: Browse/manage files from browser.

entries.name: BFpilot
entries.author: ItsBlurf
entries.desc: Lightweight PS5 file manager – browser based.
entries.notes: Minimal alternative to heavier managers.

entries.name: NetDis / PS5-NetDis
entries.author: eladharels
entries.desc: Network diagnostic payload — lists every TCP/UDP socket on a jailbroken PS5 (listening ports, connections, owner process + title ID, reachable from network vs localhost only). Live page in console browser or phone.
entries.notes: Send `NetDis.elf` to 9021; UI at `http://<ps5-ip>:8070`. Homescreen Media tile. Binary: `NetDis-org_v1.0.0.elf`. Useful before starting tools that need a free port.

entries.name: Prospero-Menu
entries.author: StonedModder
entries.desc: Community expandable overlay system for jailbroken PS5 (Tesla Menu style). Drop-in overlays (program `.ovl` or pure JSON menus). Accessible at any time without web UIs.
entries.notes: Overlays live in `/data/ProsperoMenu/overlays/`. Bundled: Fan Control, Console Tools, Games, App Dumper, Elf-Updater, Quick Launch. Supports boot animation / splash via elfdir addon.

entries.name: LiveShell
entries.author: ZiZc3
entries.desc: Animated video wallpapers for the PS5 home screen (LiveShell Engine). Discover tab with hundreds of wallpapers, per-game/app videos (experimental), PS Store-only mode, sound support, look effects (Dim/Vignette/Haze), parallax, rest-mode resume, phone/PC remote control.
entries.notes: Load `liveshell.elf`. Videos go in `/data/LiveShell/video` or USB `liveshell/` folder. H.264/HEVC ≤1080p only (4K not yet). Pause while games run so they keep the video decoder. Current version ~v1.3.

entries.name: PS-Play
entries.author: MounirHero
entries.desc: All-in-one media hub for jailbroken PS5 — DLNA receiver, DLNA/UPnP browser, native Stremio client, IPTV/Live TV and USB playback. Minimal AMOLED-black UI.
entries.notes: Based on Prospero Player; Stremio integration from Nuvio Portable.

entries.name: ProsperoStore
entries.author: darkxex
entries.desc: Native PS5 homebrew app store (title `PPSA99000`) for the catalog at prosperostore.net / homebrew.page. Browse, install, update, uninstall from the couch; signed catalog with download verification.
entries.notes: Aggregator only — apps belong to their own devs. Needs ShadowMountPlus (≥1.7beta4) + ELF loader on 9021; ships a one-shot Lapy helper if no resident Lapy is running. Previous folders kept under `/data/prosperostore/previous/<TITLE ID>` on update. Catalog fallback mirror: darkxex.github.io (signature-checked). Alpha ~v1.000.100. Binary: `ProsperoStore-org_v1.000.100` (native app / FFPKG style, not a single ELF).

entries.name: Orbit Store
entries.author: saawant12
entries.desc: Modern PS5 download manager with native TV app, phone controls, and Orbit Zero (Mac/Windows/Linux). Browse ~1600 games (PS5 + PS4), compare sources/formats, single-file downloads to console or attached drive. Catalogue updates automatically.
entries.notes: Sources include Archive.org, Vikingfile, AkiraBox. Optional TorBox + Archive.org sign-in. Library integrates with ShadowMount. Always free. Latest beta ~v1.3.5.

entries.name: RecompStore
entries.author: elripalda
entries.desc: Homebrew app store for jailbroken PS5 that installs and updates native ports of recompiled games. Bring your own disc.
entries.notes: Focused on recompiled / ported titles rather than dumps.

entries.name: RemotePFS
entries.author: PSBrew
entries.desc: Linux SBC service that emulates an exFAT USB mass storage device via USB OTG, presenting files from a remote Synology NAS to a jailbroken PS5 via ShadowMountPlus.
entries.notes: Hardware bridge: NAS → SBC → fake USB → PS5. Pairs with ShadowMountPlus.

entries.name: ps5-payloads-mirror
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.desc: Automated mirror of useful PS5 payloads with version tracking, source links, and direct downloads. Excellent living reference list.
entries.notes: Keep an eye on this for new releases.

entries.name: PS5LinkCentalizer
entries.author: pedrohti
entries.desc: Community link hub for the PS5 jailbreak scene. Auto-updates project data from GitHub.
entries.notes: Good discovery source.

entries.name: zecoxao.github.io
entries.author: zecoxao
entries.desc: Host of many historical PS scene sites and tools.
entries.notes: Useful for older payloads and documentation.

entries.name: MkPFS
entries.author: PSBrew
entries.desc: Tool for building PFS images from loose game files. Reads `sce_sys/param.json`. Core building block for future KmprZ compression stage.
entries.notes: Directly relevant to Stage 1 of KmprZ.

entries.name: PS5-Game-Compressor
entries.author: juma-sayeh
entries.desc: Standalone PS5 payload for compressing, unpacking, validating, and repairing ShadowMountPlus-mounted games.
entries.notes: Directly relevant to KmprZ Stage 1. Works on games already mounted via ShadowMountPlus.

entries.name: Convertidor-Pro
entries.author: TheWizWikii
entries.desc: PC automation suite (RedumpScraper ecosystem) for decrypting, converting, compressing and optimizing game backups — aimed at both emulation and real hardware.
entries.notes: Spanish-language project; useful offline prep pipeline before pushing dumps to PS5.

entries.name: ps5-custom-payloads
entries.author: TheWizWikii
entries.desc: Custom payload source repo intended for PS5 Payload Manager (multiple sources support).
entries.notes: Add via Payload Manager → Manage Sources (QR / URL).

entries.name: PS5-Repository-List
entries.author: nexgen999
entries.desc: Curated list of PS5 repositories / scene resources.
entries.notes: Good discovery index alongside PS5LinkCentalizer.

entries.name: ps5-app-dumper
entries.author: EchoStretch
entries.desc: Utility to dump application files from the console’s pfsmnt to a connected USB device.
entries.notes: Also available as built-in overlay inside Prospero-Menu.

entries.name: apr-emu-updater
entries.author: tsuramatsu1
entries.desc: PS5 payload that keeps APR Emu up to date on installed titles, managed from a web interface on the console.
entries.notes: Targets APR emulator patches on installed games.

entries.name: PS5-Stuff
entries.author: TheWizWikii
entries.desc: Collection of BD-JB ISOs, payloads and related PS5 tools/releases.
entries.notes: Useful grab-bag of scene releases.

entries.name: phantomptr/ps5upload
entries.desc: Upload tooling referenced in KmprZ credits.
entries.notes: Related to the ps5upload entry.

entries.name: etaHEN
entries.author: EchoStretch / LightningMods
entries.notes: Fast-moving mainline. Normal retention -- newer builds may carry an expiry timestamp (_ExpiYYYYMMDD).

entries.name: CheatRunner
entries.author: notmaj0r
entries.notes: unset -- fill in from release notes

entries.name: elfldr
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.notes: unset -- fill in from release notes

entries.name: PoorDS4
entries.author: ItsBlurf
entries.notes: sibling tool -- see docs/rename-map.md

entries.name: Self Decrypter: Full System
entries.author: idlesauce
entries.notes: sibling tool -- see docs/rename-map.md

entries.name: GarlicSaves
entries.author: earthonion
entries.notes: separate tool from garlic-worker, shared prefix only | Not on GitHub (Forgejo host): listed only. Add direct_url + version once you have a file link, then remove fetch:false.

entries.name: Garlic Worker
entries.author: earthonion
entries.notes: separate tool from garlic-savemgr, shared prefix only | Not on GitHub (Forgejo host): listed only. Add direct_url + version once you have a file link, then remove fetch:false.

entries.name: HWInfo Bench
entries.author: drakmor
entries.notes: separate tool from hwinfo-sysinfo, shared prefix only

entries.name: onionHEN
entries.author: aydencharles
entries.notes: unset -- fill in from release notes

entries.name: ProsperoMgr
entries.author: notmaj0r
entries.notes: All-in-one PS5 manager -- files, transfers, PKG installer, save backups, payload autoloader.

entries.name: JailbreakStore
entries.author: notmaj0r
entries.notes: unset -- fill in from release notes

entries.name: ChronicLoader
entries.author: StonedModder
entries.notes: PS5 payload updater/autoloader -- downloads from configured GitHub releases and writes autoload.txt. Same repo as the ChronicLoader entry; kept for old file names.

entries.name: PS5Library Agent
entries.author: rdiol12
entries.notes: Console-side agent ELF for the PS5Library native storefront. Pairs with PS5Library.pkg. Provides the on-console backend that the storefront UI talks to. GPL-3.0.

entries.name: PS5 PKG Manager
entries.author: itsPLK
entries.notes: Console-side PKG browser and installer (pkgmgr.elf). Scans USB and SMB shares for PKG files and installs them directly on the PS5. GPL-3.0.

entries.name: FGG Unpack
entries.author: FGGstore
entries.notes: Background watcher ELF that auto-extracts .zip and .7z archives uploaded via FTP, in-place. Great for uploading compressed game folders. Ships with .elf.json for pldmgr. GPL-3.0.

entries.name: ELF Launcher
entries.author: X-F1REBALL-X
entries.notes: Home screen tile + browser UI for sending ELF payloads to the PS5 (elfldr on port 9021). Serves launcher at port 1000. Companion to wk-autoloader. FOSS.

entries.name: WK-AutoLoader
entries.author: X-F1REBALL-X
entries.notes: WebKit-based jailbreak loader UI on port 1022. Supports FW 1.xx-5.xx, 7.00-12.00, 12.02-12.70. installer.elf. GPL-3.0.
